wall_reference: Distance to inner white-wall edges in ORIGINAL frames; see white_wall_calibration.json. Crop border is not the wall.
setup_policy: Start each robot after 0.05 m observed displacement from its first position
completion_policy: Exclude observed ordered blue completions, reviewed completion parking, and visible handling/removal. Cutoffs documented in robot_exclusions.csv.
limitations: Missing marker observations and unobserved completion times can affect counts; wall distances use approximate arena calibration. These are user-defined proximity episodes, not verified physical contacts.
